fusions.name: Strike and Slip
fusions.desc: A darting strike that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Silver Formation
fusions.desc: Looses 4 darts, spread apart, each of which deals 5 damage. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Bait Ball
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Upstream Form

riders.text: you cross it faster than you cross ground
and nothing that has to wade can reach you

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 10% faster over it, from silver your stamina recovers 15% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
